voicemail_message: Hi, you've reached Ben's Electric Solutions. We're sorry we missed your call. Please leave a message and we'll get back to you during our next business day.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The full name of the caller.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_phone
post_call_analysis_data.description: The phone number provided by the caller.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The type of call: emergency, service_request, inquiry, or complaint.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_requested
post_call_analysis_data.description: The specific service the caller needs.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgency_level
post_call_analysis_data.description: The urgency: critical, high, medium, or low.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: The address or location provided by the caller.

post_call_analysis_data.name: action_taken
post_call_analysis_data.description: What action was taken: transferred, message_taken, appointment_scheduled, information_provided.

post_call_analysis_data.name: preferred_schedule
post_call_analysis_data.description: When the caller is available or prefers to be contacted back, e.g. 'tomorrow morning', 'after 3pm', 'weekdays only'.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_summary
post_call_analysis_data.description: A 1-2 sentence summary of the caller's problem or request.
examples: Caller reported a power outage in their basement and needs emergency service.
Customer wants to schedule an electrical inspection for their new home.

analysis_successful_prompt: The agent successfully collected caller information and either transferred the call, took a message, or resolved the inquiry.
analysis_summary_prompt: Summarize the call outcome: who called, what they needed, and what action was taken.
analysis_user_sentiment_prompt: Rate the caller's sentiment from 1-5 (1=very negative, 5=very positive) based on their tone throughout the call.
